no_adcom_quote.quote: Vorinostat was not presented to the Oncology Drug Advisory Committee.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the ZOLINZA (vorinostat) NDA021991 original approval. The Medical Review states under Section 8.5 Advisory Committee Meeting that vorinostat was not presented to the Oncology Drugs Advisory Committee, and the Administrative Correspondence filing checklist lists the Advisory Committee Meeting date as N/A. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
